The Science Behind ProVet+

Where biophysics meets clinical nutrition

The next evolution in veterinary nutrition sits at the intersection of biophysics and clinical formulation. Rather than simply adding more of an active ingredient, ProVet+ asks a different question: can we make the nutrients already in the bowl work harder?

Molecular Activation Technology (MAT)

Catalysis® Bioactive compounds are loaded directly into each ProVet+ kibble at a 5% inclusion rate — ensuring every single piece is saturated with the active ingredient matched to its condition, rather than relying on a topical coating or separate supplement.
